counters.name: Mainland visa
counters.note: French 30-day visa-free, policy valid through Dec 31 2026. Hong Kong is separate and does not count. Planned Dec 21 exit = day 29, a one-day buffer.

blocks.heading: 🛫 Out — Sat Nov 21
items: **Etihad EY608 + EY888** · TLV 14:00 → Abu Dhabi → **Beijing Daxing (PKX) 08:45 Sun Nov 22** · ✅ booked, PNR 8CR7MR
12h45 total, one stop · arrival is **Daxing (PKX)**, not Capital

blocks.heading: 🛬 Back — Sat Dec 26
items: **Etihad EY871 + EY609** · HKG 19:35 → Abu Dhabi → **TLV 04:35 Dec 27**
15h40, one stop · Cathay's HKG–TLV nonstop is **not returning** for these dates

blocks.heading: ✈️ Internal flights — all three booked
items: **Dec 11 · Beijing → Zhangjiajie** — departs **PEK (Capital), not Daxing** · Air China CA1953, the only evening nonstop (winter timetable may move — re-verify Sept–Oct) · fallbacks: CA9659 morning · CA8609 ex-Daxing · via Changsha + HSR
**Dec 16 · Chongqing → Lijiang** — Sichuan Airlines 3U8011, evening, lands ~22:00
**Dec 21 · Kunming → Hong Kong** — the visa-day exit, China Eastern MU733 Business, early afternoon so later flights stay as recovery

blocks.heading: 🚄 Getting there
items: Nov 22: **PKX → Yantai flight** ~1h25, $70–180 (afternoon) — Air China only, not daily, **Sunday operation unconfirmed → book the day winter schedules publish (Sept–Oct)**
Plan B if no Sunday flight: PKX → Beijing South (taxi/metro ~1h) → HSR to Yantai ~5h ($60–70), evening arrival — tell the academy
**No academy pickup on Sundays** (pickup = Mon–Thu, train stations only) — taxi from airport/station ~$50; email ahead for the Chinese-address card

blocks.heading: 🛏 Sleep
items: Academy single room w/ private bathroom — **extra cost, reserve ahead** (base price = shared twin)

dayRows.label: Mon–Fri
dayRows.text: 6am run & basics → breakfast → morning block (forms, stances, kicks) → lunch → afternoon block (**Sanda pads & conditioning** — expect technique over live sparring in a 2-week stint) → optional evening: Mandarin / calligraphy. Lights out ~21:30 · Saturday is lighter/optional — confirm.

dayRows.label: Sundays
dayRows.text: Off — Yantai seaside, laundry, recover. Nov 29: **book Forbidden City tickets online** (window opens 7 days ahead!) + the Yantai gear run.

blocks.heading: 💰 Costs
items: $890 flat month + $100 deposit = ~$990–1,090 · + **~$55 mandatory winter uniform** on arrival
No published 2-week rate ($890/mo or $70/day) — confirm in writing

blocks.heading: 💡 Tips
items: Masters scale intensity to you — pace for the month of travel after
Bring: training shoes, layers (official Dec range −8 to +7°C), **hand wraps + mouthguard**, any protein you like · academy requires proof of insurance

recoBlocks.heading: 🎯 See & do
items: **Penglai Pavilion** day trip — sea-cliff tower from 1061, near-empty in December; Penglai "small noodles" for breakfast
**Changyu Wine Culture Museum** — China's oldest winery (1892), tasting included; indoor Sunday option
**Yantai Hill Park** — 1905 lighthouse + old treaty-port consulates, free
**Suochengli old quarter** — 600-year walled-town lanes, black-tiled Shandong courtyards

recoBlocks.heading: 🍜 Food & drink
items: **Sanhe Yuan** 三和园, Chaoyang Food Street — Yantai's signature mackerel dumplings (bayu jiaozi)
**Fushan hand-pulled noodles** 福山大面 — 200-year noodle tradition, seafood soup topping

recoBlocks.heading: 💡 Good to know
items: Verified: pickup runs **Mon–Thu, train stations only — no Sunday pickup**; plan the ~$50 taxi
Bohai sea wind is brutal in Nov–Dec — thermal base layers for outdoor training blocks

blocks.heading: 🚄 Getting there
items: Dec 5 morning: **fly Yantai → Beijing** (~1.5h, ~$80) — protects the Sanlitun night · train fallback ~5h (fastest 4h51), $60–70, arrives Beijing South

blocks.heading: 🛏 Sleep — the split (locked)
items: **Dec 5–7:** CHAO Sanlitun ~$376 — design hotel with the bars at the door for the Sat/Sun peak nights
**Dec 7–9:** The Orchid, Baochao Hutong ~$236 — hutong-silent recovery nights, closest base to Qinghe · **9 rooms, book refundable NOW** · confirm the early bag drop

dayRows.label: Dec 5
dayRows.text: Travel from Yantai · check into **CHAO** · **big Sanlitun night** — Taikoo Li, bar street · end it with a **midnight massage at Qushui Lanting 曲水兰亭** — leave the bars ~23:15, 15–20-min DiDi, ~20-min entry ritual, then treatment + pools + midnight buffet (~¥1,500–2,500 all-in) · **on check-in have CHAO's desk confirm late arrivals + book it** · fallback: Bodhi 菩提, 5-min walk, in the chair by 23:30

dayRows.label: Dec 6 Sun
dayRows.text: **Forbidden City** (booked Nov 29, passport = ticket) → Jingshan Park sunset over the roofs → evening out in Sanlitun → **Bodhi tuina + cupping** after dinner (~¥288/90 min)

dayRows.label: Dec 7 Mon
dayRows.text: **Great Wall wild-wall trek** — 6:30 pickup at CHAO (checked out, **backpack rides in the driver's trunk all day**) → Jinshanling → Tower 22 (in-gate; Wohushan extension = booking-time call), ~7km / 3.5–5h, heading down by ~13:30, out the East Gate before 15:00 → driver drops you + bag at **the Orchid** ~17:30 → deep tuina near Gulou (~¥220) → early sleep

dayRows.label: Dec 8 Tue
dayRows.text: 🧖 **Pressure-off spa day** — optional clinical morning at Beijing Massage Hospital 北京按摩医院 (the 1958 blind-massage institution, ~¥100–200) → all-day hot springs at Jiuhua Resort (Xiaotangshan, ~1h north; ¥138 day pass, 70+ pools; quieter alternative: Chunhuiyuan 春晖园) · early night. Legs fresh for skiing.

dayRows.label: Dec 9
dayRows.text: Short high-speed train to Chongli — skiing 🎿

blocks.heading: 💰 Costs
items: Hotels ~$612 (split) · wild-wall guide + driver ~$180 · spa day ~$40 · massages ~$90–110 (3 sessions) · Palace ~$6

blocks.heading: 💡 Tips
items: Palace closed Mondays — Sun Palace / Mon wall is deliberate

Default = the stretch **inside Jinshanling's own gate** (ends at East Five-Window Tower) — Wohushan is a separate Gubeikou section behind a military-zone detour, guide-only · the Simatai crossing is illegal & blocked

recoBlocks.heading: 🎯 See & do
items: **Temple of Heaven** — imperial altar in winter frost, morning tai chi crowds
**Lama Temple (Yonghegong)** — 18m sandalwood Buddha, walkable from the hutongs; winter hours to 16:30
**Summer Palace** — off-season quiet, Kunming Lake starts freezing over
**Shichahai / Houhai lakes at dusk** — willow-lined hutong lakesides, free (rinks usually open only late Dec/Jan)

recoBlocks.heading: 🍜 Food & drink
items: **Yaoji Chaogan** by the Drum Tower — pork-liver chaogan + baozi, the famous "Biden set" zhajiang noodles
**Dong Lai Shun**, Wangfujing — copper-pot mutton hotpot since 1903, THE Beijing winter meal
**Hai Wan Ju** — old-Beijing zhajiangmian in big bowls, very cheap
**Siji Minfu**, Dengshikou — Beijing's most beloved Peking duck house, ¥150–250 pp; expect a queue
**Da Dong** — Michelin-starred "superlean" roast duck, ¥300–500 pp
**TRB Hutong** — one-star French tasting menu in a 600-year temple courtyard; ¥1,000+ pp (lunch cheaper) — the one big splurge

recoBlocks.heading: 🎭 Shows & music
items: **Lao She Teahouse**, Qianmen — 90-min variety night: opera, acrobatics, face-changing, kung fu + snacks, ¥180–580
**Liyuan Theatre** — teahouse-style Peking opera highlights (19:30) with tea and snacks
**NCPA "the Egg"** — early-Dec orchestra/opera, start of New Year concert season; book ahead, popular nights sell out
**Beijing Concert Hall** — Vienna-style Strauss/New Year and chamber programs in December (Damai)

recoBlocks.heading: 💡 Good to know
items: Forbidden City tickets release **~20:00 Beijing time, exactly 7 days ahead** (WeChat mini-program 故宫博物院) — passport number must match, passport = ticket
Winter: the Jinshanling tourist bus doesn't run & its cable car often shuts — the driver plan is right; Mutianyu is the easy fallback

blocks.heading: 🚄 Getting there
items: Dec 9: Beijing North / Qinghe → **Taizicheng** on the 2022 Olympic HSR line, ~1h (~¥90) · resort shuttles meet the station

blocks.heading: 🛏 Sleep — slope-side
items: Slope-side at Thaiwoo or Taizicheng village — ⏳ not booked yet, peak season

dayRows.label: Dec 9
dayRows.text: Arrive midday · gear fitting · first afternoon on the **magic-carpet beginner zone**

dayRows.label: Dec 10
dayRows.text: **Group lesson + full practice day** on the greens — empty weekday slopes; stop while it's still fun

dayRows.label: Dec 11
dayRows.text: **Clean travel day** (no rushed morning ski): train back to Beijing → **PEK (not Daxing)** → afternoon flight to Zhangjiajie ✈️

blocks.heading: 💰 Costs
items: Lift ~$60–80/day · full rental incl. jacket ~$40/day · group lesson ~$50–70 · slope hotel ~$100/n

blocks.heading: 💡 Tips
items: **Greens only** — a whole month of trekking is downstream; an injury here wrecks it
Rent everything on-site · effective temp can hit −20°C — base layer + face cover

recoBlocks.heading: 🎿 Which resort
items: **Thaiwoo** — closest to Taizicheng station, strong ski school with English lessons; easiest first-timer base
**Genting Secret Garden** — 2022 Olympic freestyle venue, best alpine scenery
**Wanlong** — earliest opener, most open terrain in early December

recoBlocks.heading: 💡 Good to know
items: Season opens late Oct — Dec 9–11 is peak base; book the English group-lesson slot ahead, they fill
Hebei winter haze can flatten the light some days — take the clearest morning

stops.name: Zhangjiajie
stops.whenLabel: Fri Dec 11 → Mon Dec 14 · 2n park + 1n city

blocks.heading: 🚄 Getting there
items: Dec 11 eve: Beijing **(PEK)** → Zhangjiajie flight ~2h40 (Air China CA1953), then ~40 min to Wulingyuan · fallbacks: CA9659 morning / CA8609 ex-Daxing / via Changsha + HSR

blocks.heading: 🛏 Sleep — two bases
items: Dec 11–13: Peakcap Hostel, 5 min from the park gate (Wulingyuan)
Dec 13–14: city, next to the Tianmen cableway

dayRows.label: Dec 12
dayRows.text: Walk in along **Golden Whip Stream** valley, then the **stone-step ascent** (~2h, start ~07:30) to Yuanjiajie & the **Avatar Hallelujah pillars** — the on-foot way up, not the elevator

dayRows.label: Dec 13
dayRows.text: Tianzi Mountain viewpoints + the quiet **Yangjiajie** circuit (One Step to Heaven, Natural Great Wall, Corridor of Cliffs) — the park's real trekking terrain → evening move to the city (40 min)

dayRows.label: Dec 14
dayRows.text: **Tianmen Mountain** at opening: world's longest cableway, glass skywalk, Heaven's Gate (check ice status first thing — skip-and-go if closed) → **mid-afternoon** direct train to Chongqing (~2h)

blocks.heading: 💰 Costs
items: Park pass ~$35 · Tianmen ~$40 · hotels ~$85

blocks.heading: 💡 Tips
items: Start at first entry (~07:30) so the on-foot ascents finish in daylight (sunset ~17:45)
Tianmen cable car / skywalk pause in ice — take your clearest-forecast morning, skip if closed

recoBlocks.heading: 🎯 See & do
items: **Grand Canyon glass bridge (Yuntiandu)** — 380m span, 300m over the gorge, quiet in December
**Huanglong Cave** — giant karst cave with an underground river boat — the all-weather backup day
**Baofeng Lake** — "water Avatar" boat ride between the karst peaks, ~¥110

recoBlocks.heading: 🍜 Food & drink
items: **Hu Shifu Sanxiaguo** 胡师傅三下锅, downtown — Tujia "three-down-the-pot" smoked-bacon dry pot, since 1958, ~¥63
**Xibu Ancient Street**, Wulingyuan — night-market snack lane open till 23:30

recoBlocks.heading: 💡 Good to know
items: Check Tianmen cableway/skywalk status **each morning** — it closes in ice; spend your clearest-forecast day there (rime ice is spectacular when open)

blocks.heading: 🚄 Getting there
items: Dec 14 eve: direct HSR from Zhangjiajie West (~2h), metro/taxi to Jiefangbei

blocks.heading: 🛏 Sleep — the view splurge ★
items: Houju High-Altitude River-View Hotel · $17–40 · **high floor, river-facing** (Jiefangbei / Hongya Cave area)

dayRows.label: Dec 14 eve
dayRows.text: **Hongya Cave at night** 洪崖洞 + Qiansimen bridge viewpoint — the cyberpunk shot

dayRows.label: Dec 15
dayRows.text: Ciqikou old quarter 磁器口 → Liziba train-through-building → **Eling Park / Testbed 2 at golden hour** (free two-rivers panorama) → **Ronghui Hot Springs** soak → **Chongqing 1949** show (English earpiece, ¥150 deposit)

dayRows.label: Dec 16
dayRows.text: **Full day in Chongqing** (the only nonstop to Lijiang is evening) → **Sichuan Airlines 20:20 flight, arrive Lijiang ~22:00** ✈️ · hotpot lunch, more Ciqikou/viewpoints before the airport run ~18:00

blocks.heading: 💰 Costs
items: Hotel ~$70 · 1949 show ~$50 · hot spring ~$20

blocks.heading: 💡 Tips
items: Read 10 min on the 1949 setting beforehand — doubles the impact
Order hotpot "micro-spicy" (微辣) — they mean it

recoBlocks.heading: 🎯 See & do
items: **Yangtze River Cableway at night** — buy one-way from the Jiefangbei side late evening, walk back over Dongshuimen Bridge (midday queues hit 1h+)
**Shibati stepped old town at dusk** — Ming/Qing stone steps lit by lanterns from ~18:00, 500m from the hotel
**Testbed 2 (Eling Erchang) + Eling Park** — banknote-factory arts quarter with a free two-rivers panorama

recoBlocks.heading: 🍜 Food & drink
items: **Hua Shi Wanza Mian**, Bayi Road (200m from Jiefangbei) — pea xiaomian, the classic breakfast, ~$2
**Chen Mahua** at Ciqikou — crispy fried dough twists since 1937
**Suanlafen stalls**, Bayi Road — hot-and-sour sweet-potato glass noodles, ~¥10
**Yanshe Featured Hot Pot** 滟设火锅, Nanbin Road — Black Pearl 6 years running: tasting-menu hotpot, own yin-yang pot, river-confluence night views, ~¥498 set, reserve ahead
**Camellia Seasons** 山茶四季, MixC South — Black Pearl refined Sichuan, ~¥250–300 pp

recoBlocks.heading: 🎭 Shows & music
items: **Centennial Chongqing Teahouse** 百年重庆茶馆, near Jiefangbei — face-changing, long-spout teapot kung-fu, acrobatics with gaiwan tea, ~1h, ¥68–128
**Chongqing Grand Theatre**, Jiangbeizui — December = New Year Concert season + visiting orchestras (WeChat / Damai / Trip.com)

recoBlocks.heading: 💡 Good to know
items: December fog often blocks views until ~9am and dulls night panoramas — save viewpoints for the clearest evening; waterproof shoes for wet stone steps

blocks.heading: 🚄 Getting there
items: Dec 16: Chongqing → Lijiang direct flight ~1h40 (3U8011, lands 22:00) · 2,400m — go easy on arrival night

blocks.heading: 🛏 Sleep — Dayan old town, north side
items: Mama Naxi Guesthouse · $20–30 · **arranges the Jade Dragon trip AND the gorge bag transfer — book THIS one**

dayRows.label: Dec 16
dayRows.text: **Late arrival ~22:00** (evening flight from Chongqing) — straight to the guesthouse, which suits the "go easy at 2,400m on night 1" rule · **message Mama Naxi for a late check-in**. The Shuhe evening + Naxi concert move to Dec 17.

dayRows.label: Dec 17
dayRows.text: **Jade Dragon Snow Mountain** glacier cableway (4,500m — go slow, weather call) → **Baisha village** half-day: Ming-dynasty murals, everyday Naxi life · evening: **Shuhe stroll + 20:00 Naxi Ancient Music concert** (moved here from Dec 16) or a **hot-spring soak** ~10 min from the old town — pick one, it's a full day

dayRows.label: Dec 18
dayRows.text: Early bus to Qiaotou (~2h) → gorge trek day 1

blocks.heading: 💰 Costs
items: Jade Dragon ~$60 incl. lift · Naxi ~$20 · Baisha ~$10 · hot spring ~$40 · guesthouse ~$50

blocks.heading: 💡 Tips
items: 2,400m altitude — go easy on day 1
The 90L doesn't hike: have Mama Naxi arrange the **bag transfer to Tina's** (~¥25–50) so it's waiting at the trek's end — you hike with just the daypack, no backtracking

recoBlocks.heading: 🎯 See & do
items: **Baisha Village** — quiet Naxi village with Ming-dynasty temple murals, snow-peak backdrop in clear December air
**Shuhe Ancient Town** — Dayan's older, calmer canal-side sister 4km away

recoBlocks.heading: 🍜 Food & drink
items: **Xiangshan la paigu hotpot** 象山腊排骨 — cured pork-rib hotpot, THE Lijiang winter dish; arrive before 18:00
**88 Naxi Snack**, Wuyi St — cheap Naxi sampler: baba flatbread, chickpea jelly, potato pancakes
**Lijiang baba at Zhongyi Market** — fresh from the stalls, savory or brown-sugar sweet
**Man Yi Xuan** at Amandayan, Lion Hill — the Aman resort's Naxi/Yunnan restaurant with old-town + Snow Mountain views, ¥300–500 pp, open to non-guests
**A Ma Yi Naxi Yinshi Yuan**, Wuyi St — beloved 5-table Naxi courtyard (roast fish, butter tea), ¥60–100 pp; arrive early

recoBlocks.heading: 🎭 Shows & music
items: **Yuyan Banquet** — Ming/Qing-style Naxi banquet with live music and dance while you eat, seatings ~18:30

recoBlocks.heading: 💡 Good to know
items: Keep the ¥50 old-town maintenance-fee receipt (valid a full year — also covers Baisha & Shuhe) — checked at Black Dragon Pool, inconsistently
~14°C day-night swing + fierce high-altitude UV — sunscreen by day, warm layers by night

blocks.heading: 🥾 The hike
items: Day 1 (Dec 18): Qiaotou → 28 Bends → **Halfway Guesthouse** (~5–6h) · lunch stop: **Tea Horse Guesthouse** terrace just past the Bends
Day 2 (Dec 19): high trail → Tina's (~3–4h) → shared car toward Dali (eve)
The Middle Rock valley-floor descent (Sky Ladder) is currently closed — the **high trail is the trek**, and it's fully open in December

blocks.heading: 🛏 Sleep — on the trail
items: Halfway Guesthouse · ~$20 · terrace over the gorge · **walk-in cash, do not pre-book**

blocks.heading: 💡 December on the trail
items: Dry, clear, **no snow on the trail** (only the peaks), nearly empty — best month for it
Cold nights (−1 to 10°C): down jacket for the guesthouse evening · entry ¥65 · walk-in is fine in December

recoBlocks.heading: 🎯 See & do
items: **Tiger Leaping Stone boardwalk** (Qiaotou scenic entrance) — the postcard rapids view without repeating the high trail
Push on to **Walnut Garden** (Sean's Spring Guesthouse) — the gorge's original 1983 guesthouse village, terrace under a 2,000m cliff

recoBlocks.heading: 🍜 Food & drink
items: **Naxi baba + honey** on the Halfway Guesthouse terrace — the trail staple with hot tea
**Fried goat cheese (rubing)** at Naxi Family Guesthouse, ~1.5h into the trail — ¥5–15 dishes

recoBlocks.heading: 💡 Good to know
items: **No ATMs or card payment on the trail** (Qiaotou ATMs are China-cards-only) — carry several hundred ¥ cash from Lijiang
Sun hits the trail late and it's dark by 18:00 — hot breakfast before starting, headlamp handy, rooms unheated

blocks.heading: 🚄 Getting there
items: Dec 19 eve: shared car from the gorge (~4–5h, ~$25)

blocks.heading: 🛏 Sleep — Dali OLD Town (not Xiaguan!)
items: The Jade Emu · $20–30 · by the west gate

dayRows.label: Dec 19 eve
dayRows.text: Arrive from the gorge · Renmin Rd food stalls, early night

dayRows.label: Dec 20
dayRows.text: **Rest morning — everything optional except the train**: one-way **Caicun → Xizhou** ride on the car-free Erhai shore (Didi back) — early risers: sunrise at **Longkan Wharf**'s red-metasequoia boardwalk + baba pancake · **Bai three-course tea** at a Zhoucheng inheritor workshop → the fixed item: **afternoon HSR to Kunming** (~2h; the station is in Xiaguan, 30–45 min from the old town), sleep there for the exit 🛫

blocks.heading: 💡 Tips
items: "Dali" on train apps = Xiaguan station, 30 min from the old town · e-bikes need no licence, rent in town

recoBlocks.heading: 🎯 See & do
items: **Cangshan Ximatan cableway** to ~3,900m — snow-dusted peaks + Erhai views; or the flat 18km **Jade Belt Road** at 2,600m
**Three Pagodas of Chongsheng Temple** — 1,000-year Dali Kingdom icon, 10 min from the old town
**Renmin Road at night** — food stalls + buskers near Erhai Gate

recoBlocks.heading: 🍜 Food & drink
items: **MeiZi Jing (Plum Well)** — 200-year Bai courtyard: tile-roasted beef, hot-and-sour Erhai fish, house plum wine ~¥30
**Grilled er kuai stalls**, E Renmin Rd — charcoal rice-cake breakfast wrap, ¥3–5
**Rushan "milk fan" skewers** with rose jam — the Bai cheese snack, a few ¥
**Duan's Kitchen**, Renmin Rd area — Dali's best-known Bai restaurant, ¥80–150 pp; queue at dinner

recoBlocks.heading: 🎭 Shows & music
items: **Bai Three-Course Tea** at Yan Family Courtyard, Xizhou — the san dao cha ceremony (bitter, sweet, aftertaste) with live Bai song-and-dance in a historic mansion

recoBlocks.heading: 💡 Good to know
items: Ximatan closes in high wind and tops out near 3,900m — clear morning, hat + gloves, walk slowly up there

stops.name: Kunming — exit safety night
stops.warn: 🛂 **Why this night exists:** planned exit Dec 21 = **day 29** — the legal deadline is **Dec 22 at 24:00** (the 30-day count starts the day AFTER entry; embassy-verified). Sleeping in Kunming means you **wake in the exit city** with all three daily Kunming→HK flights as buffer, instead of gambling a same-day Dali train + flight. If Dec 21 completely melts down, **Dec 22 is still a legal exit day** — that is the real last resort, not overstay.

blocks.heading: 🚄 Getting there
items: Dec 20 afternoon: Dali → Kunming HSR ~2h (~$15, very frequent) — **book Dec 6 when the window opens**

blocks.heading: 🛏 Sleep — on the airport metro line
items: Comfortable hotel near Kunming South station / airport line

dayRows.label: Dec 20 eve
dayRows.text: Arrive · **Kunming "crossing-the-bridge" rice noodles** (guoqiao mixian) — the city's signature bowl

dayRows.label: Dec 21
dayRows.text: Easy morning — **Green Lake Park** (winter gulls) or Yuantong Temple · closer-to-airport option: **Guandu Ancient Town** (1458 Vajrasana pagoda) → **13:50 flight to Hong Kong** · mainland day 29, exit ✓

blocks.heading: 💡 Tips
items: MU733 is early afternoon — the later same-day departures are your recovery if it's disrupted (all three dailies are China Eastern; deep fallback = fly Kunming→Shenzhen + cross to HK by land)
Changshui airport ~1h from downtown — leave margin

blocks.heading: 🚄 Getting there
items: Dec 21 afternoon: Kunming → HKG (MU733, lands 16:05) · A21 bus / Airport Express to Tsim Sha Tsui · French passport: 90 days visa-free

blocks.heading: 🛏 Sleep — TST waterfront
items: The Salisbury – YMCA (harbour-view = cheapest amazing view in HK, ~$150–190; simple room ~$110) · alternative: Hotel ICON (~$250 upgrade) · backup: The Kowloon Hotel
**Book NOW, refundable** — Christmas sells out

dayRows.label: Dec 22
dayRows.text: **Macau day trip** — earliest ferry (pre-book both legs): Historic Centre + Ruins of St. Paul's before the crowds, then quiet **Coloane village** + Lord Stow's egg tarts → back to HK for dinner

dayRows.label: Dec 23 Wed
dayRows.text: **Dragon's Back hike** → Big Wave Bay / Shek O seafood lunch (weekday, peak HK hiking season) → evening **Happy Valley Wednesday races** (HK$10 — confirm the 2026/27 fixture)

dayRows.label: Dec 24
dayRows.text: **The Peak** (morning clarity) → Central + mid-levels → WinterFest + **Symphony of Lights 20:00** → Star Ferry crossing at night

dayRows.label: Dec 25
dayRows.text: Christmas: dim sum brunch (splurge: Lung King Heen) → Lantau **Big Buddha** + Ngong Ping → **Tai O fishing village**

dayRows.label: Dec 26
dayRows.text: Slow morning → M+ / last shopping → **19:35 flight home** 🛫 (be at HKG by ~16:30)

blocks.heading: 💰 Costs
items: Hotel $550–950 (5n) · food ~$40/day here

blocks.heading: 💡 Tips
items: Octopus card via app on day 1 · Star Ferry = $0.40 for a million-dollar view · **no VPN needed in Hong Kong**

recoBlocks.heading: 🎯 See & do
items: **Happy Wednesday races**, Happy Valley — HK$10 entry, floodlit racing under skyscrapers
**Chi Lin Nunnery + Nan Lian Garden** — free Tang-style nunnery and garden, the quiet counterpoint to Christmas crowds
**Dragon's Back hike** to Shek O — December is peak hiking weather; bus 9 from Shau Kei Wan MTR

recoBlocks.heading: 🍜 Food & drink
items: **Australia Dairy Company**, Jordan — scrambled-egg toast + steamed milk pudding · **closed Thursdays = Dec 24**, go Dec 22/25/26
**Yat Lok**, Stanley St, Central — Michelin-starred roast goose leg, ~HK$100–200, cash only · **closed Wednesdays = Dec 23** — go Dec 24 after the Peak
**Kau Kee**, Gough St — 90-year-old beef brisket noodles (try curry tendon), expect a queue
**T'ang Court**, The Langham (5-min walk in TST) — three Michelin stars for 11 straight years; set lunch is a fraction of dinner
**Lung King Heen**, Four Seasons — first Chinese restaurant ever to hold three stars; dim sum lunch with harbour views (~HK$800–1,000) — could BE your Dec 25 brunch

recoBlocks.heading: 🎭 Shows & music
items: **Afternoon tea at The Peninsula Lobby** — HK's tea ritual since 1928 with a live string ensemble; walk-in only, queue early
**Aqua Luna junk cruise** timed to the 20:00 Symphony of Lights — red-sail junk from TST Pier 1, ~HK$330 with a drink
**HK Philharmonic**, Cultural Centre (next to your hotel) — Christmas-week programs cluster Dec 21–23, ~HK$200–480
**HK Oratorio Society** — annual December Messiah/Christmas concert; a Dec 2026 Cultural Centre date is flagged, details TBA

recoBlocks.heading: 💡 Good to know
items: Dec 24–26 are public holidays — **book any sit-down Christmas dinner ahead** (~90% reservation rates) · carry HKD cash for the old-school spots

dayPlans.title: Departure day
planItems: TLV Ben Gurion Terminal 3 — be there by ~11:00 for the 14:00 EY608
Abu Dhabi layover 19:15 → 21:20 (2h05, Terminal A)

checklists.title: Before you fly
checklists.note: All of this must work BEFORE landing.

items.label: **Alipay** — link the foreign card, test a real charge before flying. Everything in China is QR.
**WeChat Pay** — same; also the platform for ticket mini-programs (Forbidden City 故宫博物院).

**NordVPN** — installed, logged in, set to **NordWhisper / obfuscated**, a few servers favorited. Default NordLynx is blocked. nordvpn.com is unreachable inside China, so this must be done BEFORE landing.
**Travel eSIM** (Airalo/Holafly) ~$25–40 — roaming data bypasses the firewall.
**Home SIM stays active with roaming SMS** — Alipay, WeChat, 12306 and bank 3-D Secure all verify by SMS. Enable bank app-push as backup.
**CDAC** — China Digital Arrival Card, file online before the Nov 21 flight.
**12306** — register + verify on the passport by early Nov (3–5 day manual review).
**AMap Global** — Google Maps' China data is offset even on VPN; AMap gives exact metro exit numbers.
**DiDi** — or the mini-program inside Alipay/WeChat. In-app driver chat auto-translates.
**Trip.com app** — all three domestic flights live in "My Bookings".

infoCards.heading: Visa — the one unforgivable number
items: French passport: **30 days visa-free**, policy valid through Dec 31 2026.
The count starts **the day AFTER entry** (embassy-verified). Entry Nov 22 → day 1 is Nov 23.
**Legal deadline: Dec 22, 24:00.** Planned exit Dec 21 = day 29, a 1-day buffer.
Hong Kong is separate and does not count against it. A mainland re-entry from HK starts a fresh visa-free window (and needs a new CDAC).
No extensions. Overstay ≤10 days = warning; ¥500/day from day 11. Still: do not let the Dec 21 flight slip.

infoCards.heading: The 20 kg rule
items: All three domestic flights cap checked baggage at **20 kg** (CA1953 +5 kg cabin, 3U8011 +8 kg cabin).
Etihad allows 40 kg — so the bag can only grow again after Hong Kong (MU733 Business is 2 × 32 kg).
Keep the Traker 90 half-empty leaving home; shed worn-out training kit as you go.

infoCards.heading: Power banks
items: Domestic China flights **ban power banks without a clear 3C logo** — and any recalled/faulty ones.
Check yours before Nov 21; buy a 3C-marked one in Yantai if in doubt.

infoCards.heading: Airport traps
items: **Dec 11 departs PEK (Capital), NOT Daxing** — you land at Daxing on Nov 22 but leave from Capital in December.
CA1953 is the only evening nonstop and is fog-prone. Fallbacks: CA9659 morning · CA8609 ex-Daxing · Changsha + HSR.
Winter schedules firm up in autumn — re-verify all internal flight times Sept–Oct.

infoCards.heading: Kunyu arrival
items: **No Sunday pickup** — academy pickup runs Mon–Thu, train stations only. Nov 22 is a Sunday.
Airport/station taxi ~$50 — have the Chinese address card ready (⏳ still to request by email).
Single room with bathroom costs extra and must be reserved ahead. +$55 mandatory winter uniform on arrival.
The academy requires proof of insurance. Ask whether they handle PSB registration — non-hotel stays need self-registration within 24h.

infoCards.heading: Dec 16 — the late arrival
items: Chongqing → Lijiang is an **evening flight landing ~22:00**.
The Naxi Ancient Music concert moved to **Dec 17**.
Message Mama Naxi ahead for a ~22:30 check-in. Lijiang is 2,400m — go easy that night.

infoCards.heading: Trains
items: Your **passport IS the ticket** — use the manual channel (人工通道), arrive ~45 min early; gates close 4–5 min before departure.
Booking opens on a 15-day window; the sale hour varies by station (check 起售时间 in the 12306 app).
"Dali" on train apps = Xiaguan station, 30–45 min from the old town.

infoCards.heading: Hotels & registration
items: Only PSB-linked hotels can legally host foreigners — filter **"accepts foreign guests"** and keep every registration slip.
Non-hotel stays (the academy) = self-register with the PSB within 24h if they do not do it for you.

infoCards.heading: Money
items: Alipay + WeChat Pay with a foreign card — everything is QR.
~¥1,000 cash backup. **No ATMs or card payment on the gorge trail** (Qiaotou ATMs are China-cards-only) — carry several hundred ¥ from Lijiang.
Hong Kong uses HKD + cards; carry some cash for the old-school food spots.
Trip.com gift card ~$298 left — earmarked for cheap mainland hotels.

infoCards.heading: Medication
items: Codeine and tramadol count as narcotics; "-D" cold medicines (pseudoephedrine) are controlled.
Carry a doctor's letter and keep everything in original packaging.

infoCards.heading: Tickets & apps
items: Big sights sell via real-name **WeChat mini-programs at ~20:00, 7 days ahead** — set an alarm per city.
Forbidden City: mini-program 故宫博物院, winter ¥40, passport = ticket.
SF Express forwards suitcases hotel-to-hotel (~¥30–80 overnight between big cities); stations have left-luggage counters (passport needed).

infoCards.heading: Internet in China
items: Google, Gmail web and most CDNs are blocked. **This app works fully offline** — nothing in it needs the network except the "Find email" buttons.
NordVPN must be on an **obfuscated protocol (NordWhisper)**, set up before landing.
A travel eSIM roams around the firewall — often easier than the VPN.
No VPN needed in Hong Kong.

infoCards.heading: The VPN, specifically
items: nordvpn.com is **blocked inside China** — you cannot install or fix it once you land. Before Nov 21: install NordVPN, log in, switch the protocol to **NordWhisper / obfuscated** (the default NordLynx is blocked), favorite a few servers, and confirm it actually connects.
